name: Emma McGregor
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Emma's approach is neurodiversity-affirming, queer-inclusive and trauma-informed. She believes that naming and exploring systems in therapy - such as capitalism, patriarchy, cisheteronormativity - matters. Treatment areas include PTSD, childhood sexual trauma, long term/complex trauma and sexual pain.
specialties: queer-inclusive, trauma, PTSD, complex trauma, sexual trauma, sexual pain, neurodivergence

name: Charlotte Ford
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Charlotte utilises a holistic, trauma-informed approach. She is passionate about exploring attachment patterns, sexual functioning and the mind-body connection. Treatment areas include LGBTIQA+ support, poly/non-monogamy, gender questioning support and adult sexual trauma.
specialties: sex therapy, LGBTIQA+ support, gender questioning support, sexual trauma, sexual pain, PMDD, endometriosis

name: Juliette Kingsford
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Juliette is neurodiversity affirming, sex positive, LGBTQIA+ inclusive, and kink and poly friendly. Treatment areas include sexual pain, LGBTIQA+ support, gender questioning support, PTSD and relational/attachment trauma.
specialties: sex therapy, LGBTQIA+, kink friendly, poly friendly, gender questioning support, PTSD, attachment trauma

name: Pia Cole
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Pia utilises an intersectional feminist lens and queer theory to understand sociocultural context and identity as important influences on well-being, with a research background in positive body image, gender diversity, and social issues. Treatment areas include LGBTIQA+ support, sex work support, gender questioning support and long term/complex trauma.
specialties: queer theory, LGBTIQA+ support, gender diversity, gender questioning support, sex work support, non-monogamy, complex trauma, body image

name: Elizabeth Muscat
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Her practice is grounded in trauma-informed, attachment-based theory. Elizabeth enjoys working with clients on navigating a range of sexual and relationship concerns. Treatment areas include PTSD, childhood sexual trauma, adult sexual trauma, long term/complex trauma and relational/attachment trauma.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, complex trauma, sexual trauma, sexual health anxiety, neurodivergence

name: Vishnupriya Balaji
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: With a deep interest in cultural dynamics in sexuality and attachment, Vishnu brings a culturally attuned lens to her sessions and is particularly passionate about working with the CALD community. Treatment areas include sexual pain, desire dissatisfaction, poly/non-monogamy, recent trauma and relational/attachment trauma.
specialties: sexuality, CALD, sex therapy, non-monogamy, trauma, attachment trauma

name: Rachelle King
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Her approach is sex-positive, gender-affirming, and person-centred. Rachelle has a background in providing affirming support for the LGBTQIA+ community, neurodivergent clients, and those in non-monogamous relationships. Treatment areas include sex work support, gender questioning support and WPATH assessments and reports.
specialties: gender-affirming, WPATH assessments, LGBTQIA+, non-monogamy, sex work support, sex therapy

name: Vicki Hutchings
title: Sexual Health Psychologist & ISHPA Supervisor
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: With a commitment to supporting individuals of all identities, sexual orientations, gender expressions, and neurotypes. Approaching therapy through a sex-positive lens; whether clients are navigating sexual health, intimacy, or gender identity, the focus is on fostering an open, affirming environment. Treatment areas include paraphilias, gender questioning support, WPATH assessments and reports, and childhood sexual trauma.
specialties: sex therapy, gender identity, WPATH assessments, LGBTIQA+ support, paraphilias, sex work support, sexual trauma

name: Dr Sarah Ashton
title: Director, Founder, Principal Sexual Health Psychologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Registered psychologist, Board-Approved Supervisor, Accredited Sexuality Educator (Society of Australian Sexologists), author, and Founder and Director of SHIPS. Her mission is to support the liberating expression of sexuality by reducing fear, isolation, and misinformation through compassionate therapy, inclusive education, and meaningful systemic change.
specialties: sexuality, sex therapy, sexuality education, supervision

name: Jasmin Quinsee
title: Clinical Manager, Sexual Health Psychologist & Relationship Therapist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Jasmin is passionate about breaking down the shame/stigma surrounding sex and sexuality. She is sex positive, LGBTIAQ+ inclusive, kink and diverse relationship structure friendly and sex work positive, inclusive of diverse relational structures (such as polyamory and non-monogamy) and sexual practices (such as kink).
specialties: sex therapy, LGBTIAQ+, kink, polyamory, sex work positive, relationship therapy, disability

name: Cassie Lieschke
title: Sexual Health Psychologist & Team Leader
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Cassie holds a special interest in the attachment and relationship space and is affirming of all relationship structures, including non-monogamous relationships. Treatment areas include gender questioning support, WPATH assessments and reports, PTSD, childhood sexual trauma and long term/complex trauma. Provides gender affirming care and is neuroaffirming in her practice.
specialties: gender affirming care, WPATH assessments, non-monogamy, sex therapy, PTSD, sexual trauma, complex trauma

name: Javiera Dastres
title: Clinical Manager, Sexual Health Psychologist & Sexologist
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Holds a Master of Science in Medicine (Sexual and Reproductive Health) in Psychosexual Therapy and is comfortable working with complex, sensitive, and stigmatised concerns without judgement. Treatment areas include LGBTIQA+ support, kink-specific support, sex work support, paraphilias, childhood sexual trauma and long term/complex trauma. Not currently taking clients.
specialties: psychosexual therapy, LGBTIQA+ support, kink-specific support, sex work support, paraphilias, sexual trauma, complex trauma

name: Michelle Pangallo
title: Sexual Health Psychologist & Supervisor
practice: SHIPS Psychology (Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services)
description: Michelle has special interest in the areas of trauma, pain, chronic illness as well as relationship and intimacy concerns. She has experience working with childhood sexual trauma, PTSD, attachment trauma and sexual issues, and is experienced in supporting the LGBTIQA+ community. Currently on parental leave.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, sexual trauma, sex therapy, LGBTIQA+, chronic pain
